tips.summary: Leave Insert mode with Esc / Ctrl-[
details: Esc leaves Insert mode
Ctrl-[ is the same command
i inserts before cursor
a inserts after cursor
As you type, completions pop up
Ctrl-n down, Ctrl-p up the list
Ctrl-y accepts, Ctrl-e dismisses

tips.summary: Insert at line start/end I / A
details: I inserts at first non-blank
A appends at end of line
Press 80i, type -, press Esc
You get a line of 80 dashes

tips.summary: Insert at true line start gI
details: gI inserts at column 1
Starts before any leading spaces

tips.summary: Resume insert at last edit gi
details: Wander off to read code, then gi
Resumes typing where you left off
o opens below and enters Insert
O opens above and enters Insert

tips.summary: Run one Normal command with Ctrl-o
details: One Normal command, back to Insert
e.g. Ctrl-o dd deletes the line
Removes the word before the cursor
Faster than holding backspace

tips.summary: Erase what you just typed Ctrl-u
details: Wipes what you typed since i or a
Press again to delete to the indent
Ctrl-t shifts the line right
Ctrl-d shifts it left
Ctrl-r 0 inserts last yank
Ctrl-r + inserts clipboard
Works at the : prompt too
Type 19*7 at the = prompt
Enter inserts 133 at the cursor
Ctrl-k a: gives ä, e' gives é
:digraphs lists all the codes
Type to overwrite text
Backspace brings the old text back
Esc leaves Replace mode
Ctrl-y copies the char above you
Ctrl-e copies the char below you
Ctrl-v then a key inserts it raw
Ctrl-v Tab adds a real tab

tips.summary: Complete a whole line Ctrl-x Ctrl-l
details: Type its start, then Ctrl-x Ctrl-l
Finds a matching line in the file

tips.summary: Complete a file path Ctrl-x Ctrl-f
details: Type part of a path, then the keys
Completes it from the file system
